verses.text_uthmani: كٓهيعٓصٓ

trs.20: Kāf, Hā, Yā, ʿAyn, Ṣād.<sup foot_note=196717>1</sup>
trs.85: Kaf Ha Ya 'Ayn Sad
trs.22: Kaf. Ha. Ya. 'Ain. Sad.
trs.203: Kâf-Hâ-Yâ-‘Aîn-Sâd. [These letters are one of the miracles of the Qur’ân, and none but Allâh (Alone) knows their meanings].

verses.text_uthmani: ذِكْرُ رَحْمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبْدَهُۥ زَكَرِيَّآ

trs.20: [This is] a mention of the mercy of your Lord to His servant Zechariah
trs.85: This is an account of your Lord’s grace towards His servant, Zachariah,
trs.22: (This is) a recital of the Mercy of thy Lord to His servant Zakariya.
trs.203: (This is) a mention of the mercy of your Lord to His slave Zakariyyâ (Zachariah).

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ نِدَآءً خَفِيًّا

trs.20: When he called to his Lord a private call [i.e., supplication].
trs.85: when he called to his Lord secretly, saying,
trs.22: Behold! he cried to his Lord in secret,
trs.203: When he called out his Lord (Allâh) a call in secret.

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى وَهَنَ ٱلْعَظْمُ مِنِّى وَٱشْتَعَلَ ٱلرَّأْسُ شَيْبًا وَلَمْ أَكُنۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّا

trs.20: He said, "My Lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled<sup foot_note=196718>1</sup> with white, and never have I been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy [i.e., disappointed].
trs.85: ‘Lord, my bones have weakened and my hair is ashen grey, but never, Lord, have I ever prayed to You in vain:
trs.22: Praying: "O my Lord! infirm indeed are my bones, and the hair of my head doth glisten with grey: but never am I unblest, O my Lord, in my prayer to Thee!
trs.203: He said: "My Lord! Indeed my bones have grown feeble, and grey hair has spread on my head, And I have never been unblest in my invocation to You, O my Lord!

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّا

trs.20: And indeed, I fear the successors<sup foot_note=196719>1</sup> after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir
trs.85: I fear [what] my kinsmen [will do] when I am gone, for my wife is barren, so grant me a successor––a gift from You––
trs.22: "Now I fear (what) my relatives (and colleagues) (will do) after me: but my wife is barren: so give me an heir as from Thyself,-
trs.203: "And verily I fear my relatives after me, and my wife is barren. So give me from Yourself an heir.

verses.text_uthmani: يَرِثُنِى وَيَرِثُ مِنْ ءَالِ يَعْقُوبَ ۖ وَٱجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّا

trs.20: Who will inherit me<sup foot_note=196720>1</sup> and inherit from the family of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, pleasing [to You]."
trs.85: to be my heir and the heir of the family of Jacob. Lord, make him well pleasing [to You].’
trs.22: "(One that) will (truly) represent me, and represent the posterity of Jacob; and make him, O my Lord! one with whom Thou art well-pleased!"
trs.203: "Who shall inherit me, and inherit (also) the posterity of Ya‘qûb (Jacob) (inheritance of the religious knowledge and Prophethood, not of wealth.). And make him, my Lord, one with whom You are Well-Pleased!"

verses.text_uthmani: يَـٰزَكَرِيَّآ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَـٰمٍ ٱسْمُهُۥ يَحْيَىٰ لَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ سَمِيًّا

trs.20: [He was told],<sup foot_note=196721>1</sup> "O Zechariah, indeed We give you good tidings of a boy whose name will be John. We have not assigned to any before [this] name."
trs.85: ‘Zachariah, We bring you good news of a son whose name will be John––We have chosen this name for no one before him.’
trs.22: (His prayer was answered): "O Zakariya! We give thee good news of a son: His name shall be Yahya: on none by that name have We conferred distinction before."
trs.203: (Allâh said) "O Zakariyyâ (Zachariah)! Verily, We give you the glad tidings of a son, whose name will be Yahyâ (John). We have given that name to none before (him)."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌ وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًا وَقَدْ بَلَغْتُ مِنَ ٱلْكِبَرِ عِتِيًّا

trs.20: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when my wife has been barren and I have reached extreme old age?"
trs.85: He said, ‘Lord, how can I have a son when my wife is barren, and I am old and frail?’
trs.22: He said: "O my Lord! How shall I have a son, when my wife is barren and I have grown quite decrepit from old age?"
trs.203: He said: "My Lord! How can I have a son, when my wife is barren, and I have reached the extreme old age."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌ وَقَدْ خَلَقْتُكَ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ تَكُ شَيْـًٔا

trs.20: [An angel] said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, for I created you before, while you were nothing.'"
trs.85: He said, ‘This is what your Lord has said: “It is easy for Me: I created you, though you were nothing before.” ’
trs.22: He said: "So (it will be) thy Lord saith, 'that is easy for Me: I did indeed create thee before, when thou hadst been nothing!'"
trs.203: He said: "So (it will be). Your Lord says: It is easy for Me. Certainly I have created you before, when you had been nothing!"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱجْعَل لِّىٓ ءَايَةً ۚ قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ ٱلنَّاسَ ثَلَـٰثَ لَيَالٍ سَوِيًّا

trs.20: [Zechariah] said, "My Lord, make for me a sign." He said, "Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three nights, [being] sound."<sup foot_note=196722>1</sup>
trs.85: He said, ‘Give me a sign, Lord.’ He said, ‘Your sign is that you will not [be able to] speak to anyone for three full [days and] nights.’
trs.22: (Zakariya) said: "O my Lord! give me a Sign." "Thy Sign," was the answer, "Shall be that thou shalt speak to no man for three nights, although thou art not dumb."
trs.203: [Zakariyyâ (Zachariah)] said: "My Lord! Appoint for me a sign." He said: "Your sign is that you shall not speak unto mankind for three nights, though having no bodily defect."

verses.text_uthmani: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلْمِحْرَابِ فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِمْ أَن سَبِّحُوا۟ بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا

trs.20: So he came out to his people from the prayer chamber and signaled to them to exalt [Allāh] in the morning and afternoon.
trs.85: He went out of the sanctuary to his people and signalled to them to praise God morning and evening.
trs.22: So Zakariya came out to his people from him chamber: He told them by signs to celebrate Allah's praises in the morning and in the evening.
trs.203: Then he came out to his people from Al-Mihrâb (a praying place or a private room), and he told them by signs to glorify Allâh’s Praises in the morning and in the afternoon.

verses.text_uthmani: يَـٰيَحْيَىٰ خُذِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ بِقُوَّةٍ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلْحُكْمَ صَبِيًّا

trs.20: [Allāh said], "O John, take the Scripture [i.e., adhere to it] with determination." And We gave him judgement [while yet] a boy
trs.85: [We said], ‘John, hold on to the Scripture firmly.’ While he was still a boy, We granted him wisdom,
trs.22: (To his son came the command): "O Yahya! take hold of the Book with might": and We gave him Wisdom even as a youth,
trs.203: (It was said to his son): "O Yahyâ (John)! Hold fast the Scripture [the Taurât (Torah)]." And We gave him wisdom while yet a child.

verses.text_uthmani: وَحَنَانًا مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَزَكَوٰةً ۖ وَكَانَ تَقِيًّا

trs.20: And affection from Us and purity, and he was fearing of Allāh
trs.85: tenderness from Us, and purity. He was devout,
trs.22: And piety (for all creatures) as from Us, and purity: He was devout,
trs.203: And (made him) sympathetic to men as a mercy (or a grant) from Us, and pure from sins [i.e. Yahyâ (John)] and he was righteous,

verses.text_uthmani: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَكُن جَبَّارًا عَصِيًّا

trs.20: And dutiful to his parents, and he was not a disobedient tyrant.
trs.85: kind to his parents, not domineering or rebellious.
trs.22: And kind to his parents, and he was not overbearing or rebellious.
trs.203: And dutiful towards his parents, and he was neither arrogant nor disobedient (to Allâh or to his parents).

verses.text_uthmani: وَسَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوْمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ يُبْعَثُ حَيًّا

trs.20: And peace be upon him the day he was born and the day he dies and the day he is raised alive.
trs.85: Peace was on him the day he was born, the day he died, and it will be on him the day he is raised to life again.
trs.22: So Peace on him the day he was born, the day that he dies, and the day that he will be raised up to life (again)!
trs.203: And Salâm (peace) be on him the day he was born, and the day he dies, and the day he will be raised up to life (again)!

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًا شَرْقِيًّا

trs.20: And mention, [O Muḥammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east.
trs.85: Mention in the Quran the story of Mary. She withdrew from her family to a place to the east
trs.22: Relate in the Book (the story of) Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place in the East.
trs.203: And mention in the Book (the Qur’ân, O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم the story of) Maryam (Mary), when she withdrew in seclusion from her family to a place facing east.

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱتَّخَذَتْ مِن دُونِهِمْ حِجَابًا فَأَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرًا سَوِيًّا

trs.20: And she took, in seclusion from them, a screen. Then We sent to her Our Angel [i.e., Gabriel], and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man.
trs.85: and secluded herself away; We sent Our Spirit to appear before her in the form of a perfected man.
trs.22: She placed a screen (to screen herself) from them; then We sent her our angel, and he appeared before her as a man in all respects.
trs.203: She placed a screen (to screen herself) from them; then We sent to her Our Ruh [angel Jibrîl (Gabriel)], and he appeared before her in the form of a man in all respects.

translation.text: then he assumed for her the likeness
then he assumed for her the likeness

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَتْ إِنِّىٓ أَعُوذُ بِٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مِنكَ إِن كُنتَ تَقِيًّا

trs.20: She said, "Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Merciful from you, [so leave me], if you should be fearing of Allāh."
trs.85: She said, ‘I seek the Lord of Mercy’s protection against you: if you have any fear of Him [do not approach]!’
trs.22: She said: "I seek refuge from thee to (Allah) Most Gracious: (come not near) if thou dost fear Allah."
trs.203: She said: "Verily! I seek refuge with the Most Gracious (Allâh) from you, if you do fear Allâh."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَـٰمًا زَكِيًّا

trs.20: He said, "I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you [news of] a pure boy [i.e., son]."
trs.85: but he said, ‘I am but a Mes-senger from your Lord, [come] to announce to you the gift of a pure son.’
trs.22: He said: "Nay, I am only a messenger from thy Lord, (to announce) to thee the gift of a holy son.
trs.203: (The angel) said: "I am only a messenger from your Lord, (to announce) to you the gift of a righteous son."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَتْ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِى بَشَرٌ وَلَمْ أَكُ بَغِيًّا

trs.20: She said, "How can I have a boy while no man has touched me and I have not been unchaste?"
trs.85: She said, ‘How can I have a son when no man has touched me? I have not been unchaste,’
trs.22: She said: "How shall I have a son, seeing that no man has touched me, and I am not unchaste?"
trs.203: She said: "How can I have a son, when no man has touched me, nor am I unchaste?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌ ۖ وَلِنَجْعَلَهُۥٓ ءَايَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَرَحْمَةً مِّنَّا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرًا مَّقْضِيًّا

trs.20: He said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, and We will make him a sign to the people and a mercy from Us. And it is a matter [already] decreed.'"
trs.85: and he said, ‘This is what your Lord said: “It is easy for Me- We shall make him a sign to all people, a blessing from Us.”’
trs.22: He said: "So (it will be): Thy Lord saith, 'that is easy for Me: and (We wish) to appoint him as a Sign unto men and a Mercy from Us': It is a matter (so) decreed."
trs.203: He said: "So (it will be), your Lord said: ‘That is easy for Me (Allâh): And (We wish) to appoint him as a sign to mankind and a mercy from Us (Allâh), and it is a matter (already) decreed, (by Allâh).’ "

translation.text: and so that We will make him

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ فَحَمَلَتْهُ فَٱنتَبَذَتْ بِهِۦ مَكَانًا قَصِيًّا

trs.20: So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place.
trs.85: And so it was ordained: she conceived him. She withdrew to a distant place
trs.22: So she conceived him, and she retired with him to a remote place.
trs.203: So she conceived him,<sup foot_note=154697>1</sup> and she withdrew with him to a far place (i.e. Bethlehem valley about 4-6 miles from Jerusalem).

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَجَآءَهَا ٱلْمَخَاضُ إِلَىٰ جِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ قَالَتْ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى مِتُّ قَبْلَ هَـٰذَا وَكُنتُ نَسْيًا مَّنسِيًّا

trs.20: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, "Oh, I wish I had died before this and was in oblivion, forgotten."
trs.85: and, when the pains of childbirth drove her to [cling to] the trunk of a palm tree, she exclaimed, ‘I wish I had been dead and forgotten long before all this!’
trs.22: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm-tree: She cried (in her anguish): "Ah! would that I had died before this! would that I had been a thing forgotten and out of sight!"
trs.203: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a date-palm. She said: "Would that I had died before this, and had been forgotten and out of sight!"

verses.text_uthmani: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَآ أَلَّا تَحْزَنِى قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا

trs.20: But he<sup foot_note=196723>1</sup> called her from below her, "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream.
trs.85: but a voice cried to her from below, ‘Do not worry: your Lord has provided a stream at your feet
trs.22: But (a voice) cried to her from beneath the (palm-tree): "Grieve not! for thy Lord hath provided a rivulet beneath thee;
trs.203: Then [the babe ‘Îsâ (Jesus) or Jibrîl (Gabriel)] cried unto her from below her, saying: "Grieve not: your Lord has provided a water stream under you.

verses.text_uthmani: وَهُزِّىٓ إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ تُسَـٰقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا

trs.20: And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.
trs.85: and, if you shake the trunk of the palm tree towards you, it will deliver fresh ripe dates for you,
trs.22: "And shake towards thyself the trunk of the palm-tree: It will let fall fresh ripe dates upon thee.
trs.203: "And shake the trunk of date-palm towards you, it will let fall fresh ripe-dates upon you."

verses.text_uthmani: فَكُلِى وَٱشْرَبِى وَقَرِّى عَيْنًا ۖ فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ ٱلْبَشَرِ أَحَدًا فَقُولِىٓ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ صَوْمًا فَلَنْ أُكَلِّمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِنسِيًّا

trs.20: So eat and drink and be contented. And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man.'"
trs.85: so eat, drink, be glad, and say to anyone you may see: “I have vowed to the Lord of Mercy to abstain from conversation, and I will not talk to anyone today.”’
trs.22: "So eat and drink and cool (thine) eye. And if thou dost see any man, say, 'I have vowed a fast to (Allah) Most Gracious, and this day will I enter into not talk with any human being'"
trs.203: "So eat and drink and be glad. And if you see any human being, say: ‘Verily! I have vowed a fast unto the Most Gracious (Allâh) so I shall not speak to any human being this day.’"

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَتَتْ بِهِۦ قَوْمَهَا تَحْمِلُهُۥ ۖ قَالُوا۟ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ لَقَدْ جِئْتِ شَيْـًٔا فَرِيًّا

trs.20: Then she brought him to her people, carrying him. They said, "O Mary, you have certainly done a thing unprecedented.
trs.85: She went back to her people carrying the child, and they said, ‘Mary! You have done something terrible!
trs.22: At length she brought the (babe) to her people, carrying him (in her arms). They said: "O Mary! truly an amazing thing hast thou brought!
trs.203: Then she brought him (the baby) to her people, carrying him. They said: "O Mary! Indeed you have brought a thing Fariyy (a mighty thing). [Tafsir Al-Tabari]

verses.text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأُخْتَ هَـٰرُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ ٱمْرَأَ سَوْءٍ وَمَا كَانَتْ أُمُّكِ بَغِيًّا

trs.20: O sister [i.e., descendant] of Aaron, your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste."
trs.85: Sister of Aaron! Your father was not an evil man; your mother was not unchaste!’
trs.22: "O sister of Aaron! Thy father was not a man of evil, nor thy mother a woman unchaste!"
trs.203: "O sister (i.e. the like) of Hârûn (Aaron)<sup foot_note=154698>1</sup>! Your father was not a man who used to commit adultery, nor your mother was an unchaste woman."

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَشَارَتْ إِلَيْهِ ۖ قَالُوا۟ كَيْفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّا

trs.20: So she pointed to him. They said, "How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a child?"
trs.85: She pointed at him. They said, ‘How can we converse with an infant?’
trs.22: But she pointed to the babe. They said: "How can we talk to one who is a child in the cradle?"
trs.203: Then she pointed to him. They said: "How can we talk to one who is a child in the cradle?<sup foot_note=154699>1</sup>"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ إِنِّى عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ ءَاتَىٰنِىَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَجَعَلَنِى نَبِيًّا

trs.20: [Jesus] said, "Indeed, I am the servant of Allāh. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet.
trs.85: [But] he said: ‘I am a servant of God. He has granted me the Scripture; made me a prophet;
trs.22: He said: "I am indeed a servant of Allah: He hath given me revelation and made me a prophet;
trs.203: "He [‘Îsâ (Jesus)] said: "Verily I am a slave of Allâh, He has given me the Scripture and made me a Prophet;<sup foot_note=154700>1</sup>"

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلَنِى مُبَارَكًا أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُ وَأَوْصَـٰنِى بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ مَا دُمْتُ حَيًّا

trs.20: And He has made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakāh as long as I remain alive
trs.85: made me blessed wherever I may be. He commanded me to pray, to give alms as long as I live,
trs.22: "And He hath made me blessed wheresoever I be, and hath enjoined on me Prayer and Charity as long as I live;
trs.203: "And He has made me blessed wheresoever I be, and has enjoined on me Salât (prayer), and Zakât, as long as I live."

verses.text_uthmani: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَتِى وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِى جَبَّارًا شَقِيًّا

trs.20: And [made me] dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant.
trs.85: to cherish my mother. He did not make me domineering or graceless.
trs.22: "(He) hath made me kind to my mother, and not overbearing or miserable;
trs.203: "And dutiful to my mother, and made me not arrogant, unblest.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّلَـٰمُ عَلَىَّ يَوْمَ وُلِدتُّ وَيَوْمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ أُبْعَثُ حَيًّا

trs.20: And peace is on me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I am raised alive."
trs.85: Peace was on me the day I was born, and will be on me the day I die and the day I am raised to life again.’
trs.22: "So peace is on me the day I was born, the day that I die, and the day that I shall be raised up to life (again)"!
trs.203: "And Salâm (peace) be upon me the day I was born, and the day I die, and the day I shall be raised alive!"

verses.text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ ۚ قَوْلَ ٱلْحَقِّ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ

trs.20: That is Jesus, the son of Mary - the word of truth about which they are in dispute.
trs.85: Such was Jesus, son of Mary. [This is] a statement of the Truth about which they are in doubt:
trs.22: Such (was) Jesus the son of Mary: (it is) a statement of truth, about which they (vainly) dispute.
trs.203: Such is ‘Îsâ (Jesus), son of Maryam (Mary). (It is) a statement of truth, about which they doubt (or dispute).

verses.text_uthmani: مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ مِن وَلَدٍ ۖ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥٓ ۚ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ

trs.20: It is not [befitting] for Allāh to take a son; exalted is He!<sup foot_note=196724>1</sup> When He decrees an affair, He only says to it, "Be," and it is.
trs.85: it would not befit God to have a child. He is far above that: when He decrees something, He says only, ‘Be,’ and it is.
trs.22: It is not befitting to (the majesty of) Allah that He should beget a son. Glory be to Him! when He determines a matter, He only says to it, "Be", and it is.
trs.203: It befits not (the Majesty of) Allâh that He should beget a son [this refers to the slander of Christians against Allâh, by saying that ‘Îsâ (Jesus) is the son of Allâh]. Glorified (and Exalted) be He (above all that they associate with Him). When He decrees a thing, He only says to it: "Be!" - and it is.<sup foot_note=154701>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ

trs.20: [Jesus said], "And indeed, Allāh is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path."
trs.85: ‘God is my Lord and your Lord, so serve Him: that is a straight path.’
trs.22: Verily Allah is my Lord and your Lord: Him therefore serve ye: this is a Way that is straight.
trs.203: [‘Îsâ (Jesus) said]: "And verily Allâh is my Lord and your Lord. So worship Him (Alone). That is the Straight Path. (Allâh’s religion of Islâmic Monotheism which He did ordain for all of His Prophets)." [Tafsir At-Tabarî]

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن مَّشْهَدِ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

trs.20: Then the factions differed [concerning Jesus] from among them, so woe to those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous Day.
trs.85: But factions have differed among themselves. What suffering will come to those who obscure the truth when a dreadful Day arrives!
trs.22: But the sects differ among themselves: and woe to the unbelievers because of the (coming) Judgment of a Momentous Day!
trs.203: Then the sects differed [i.e. the Christians about ‘Îsâ (Jesus) عليه السلام], so woe unto the disbelievers [those who gave false witness by saying that ‘Îsâ (Jesus) is the son of Allâh] from the Meeting of a great Day (i.e. the Day of Resurrection, when they will be thrown in the blazing Fire)<sup foot_note=154702>1</sup>.

verses.text_uthmani: أَسْمِعْ بِهِمْ وَأَبْصِرْ يَوْمَ يَأْتُونَنَا ۖ لَـٰكِنِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ

trs.20: How [clearly] they will hear and see the Day they come to Us, but the wrongdoers today are in clear error.
trs.85: How sharp of hearing, how sharp of sight they will be when they come to Us, although now they are clearly off course! Warn them [Muhammad] of the Day of Remorse when the matter will be decided,
trs.22: How plainly will they see and hear, the Day that they will appear before Us! but the unjust today are in error manifest!
trs.203: How clearly will they (polytheists and disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh) see and hear the Day when they will appear before Us! But the Zalimûn (polytheists and wrong-doers) today are in plain error.

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْحَسْرَةِ إِذْ قُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍ وَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

trs.20: And warn them, [O Muḥammad], of the Day of Regret, when the matter will be concluded;<sup foot_note=196725>1</sup> and [yet], they are in [a state of] heedlessness, and they do not believe.
trs.85: for they are heedless and do not believe.
trs.22: But warn them of the Day of Distress, when the matter will be determined: for (behold,) they are negligent and they do not believe!
trs.203: And warn them (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) of the Day of grief and regrets, when the case has been decided, while (now) they are in a state of carelessness, and they believe not<sup foot_note=154703>1</sup>.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَرِثُ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا وَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ

trs.20: Indeed, it is We who will inherit the earth and whoever is on it, and to Us they will be returned.
trs.85: It is We who will inherit the earth and all who are on it: they will all be returned to Us.
trs.22: It is We Who will inherit the earth, and all beings thereon: to Us will they all be returned.
trs.203: Verily We will inherit the earth and whatsoever is thereon. And to Us they all shall be returned,

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَّبِيًّا

trs.20: And mention in the Book [the story of] Abraham. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.
trs.85: Mention too, in the Quran, the story of Abraham. He was a man of truth, a prophet.
trs.22: (Also mention in the Book (the story of) Abraham: He was a man of Truth, a prophet.
trs.203: And mention in the Book (the Qur’ân) Ibrâhîm (Abraham). Verily he was a man of truth, a Prophet.

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ لِمَ تَعْبُدُ مَا لَا يَسْمَعُ وَلَا يُبْصِرُ وَلَا يُغْنِى عَنكَ شَيْـًٔا

trs.20: [Mention] when he said to his father, "O my father, why do you worship that which does not hear and does not see and will not benefit you at all?
trs.85: He said to his father, ‘Father, why do you worship something that can neither hear nor see nor benefit you in any way?
trs.22: Behold, he said to his father: "O my father! why worship that which heareth not and seeth not, and can profit thee nothing?
trs.203: When he said to his father: "O my father! Why do you worship that which hears not, sees not and cannot avail you in anything?

verses.text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى قَدْ جَآءَنِى مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِكَ فَٱتَّبِعْنِىٓ أَهْدِكَ صِرَٰطًا سَوِيًّا

trs.20: O my father, indeed there has come to me of knowledge that which has not come to you, so follow me; I will guide you to an even path.
trs.85: Father, knowledge that has not reached you has come to me, so follow me: I will guide you to an even path.
trs.22: "O my father! to me hath come knowledge which hath not reached thee: so follow me: I will guide thee to a way that is even and straight.
trs.203: "O my father! Verily there has come to me of the knowledge that which came not unto you. So follow me, I will guide you to the Straight Path.

verses.text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَبَتِ لَا تَعْبُدِ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَصِيًّا

trs.20: O my father, do not worship [i.e., obey] Satan. Indeed Satan has ever been, to the Most Merciful, disobedient.
trs.85: Father, do not worship Satan- Satan has rebelled against the Lord of Mercy.
trs.22: "O my father! serve not Satan: for Satan is a rebel against (Allah) Most Gracious.
trs.203: "O my father! Worship not Shaitân (Satan). Verily Shaitân (Satan) has been a rebel against the Most Gracious (Allâh).

verses.text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يَمَسَّكَ عَذَابٌ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ فَتَكُونَ لِلشَّيْطَـٰنِ وَلِيًّا

trs.20: O my father, indeed I fear that there will touch you a punishment from the Most Merciful so you would be to Satan a companion [in Hellfire]."
trs.85: Father, I fear that a punishment from the Lord of Mercy may afflict you and that you may become Satan’s companion [in Hell].’
trs.22: "O my father! I fear lest a Penalty afflict thee from (Allah) Most Gracious, so that thou become to Satan a friend."
trs.203: "O my father! Verily I fear lest a torment from the Most Gracious (Allâh) should overtake you, so that you become a companion of Shaitân (Satan) (in the Hell-fire)." [Tafsir Al-Qurtubî]

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ أَرَاغِبٌ أَنتَ عَنْ ءَالِهَتِى يَـٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ لَأَرْجُمَنَّكَ ۖ وَٱهْجُرْنِى مَلِيًّا

trs.20: [His father] said, "Have you no desire for my gods, O Abraham? If you do not desist, I will surely stone you, so avoid me a prolonged time."
trs.85: His father answered, ‘Abraham, do you reject my gods? I will stone you if you do not stop this. Keep out of my way!’
trs.22: (The father) replied: "Dost thou hate my gods, O Abraham? If thou forbear not, I will indeed stone thee: Now get away from me for a good long while!"
trs.203: He (the father) said: "Do you reject my gods, O Ibrâhîm (Abraham)? If you stop not (this), I will indeed stone you. So get away from me safely (before I punish you)."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْكَ ۖ سَأَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِى حَفِيًّا

trs.20: [Abraham] said, "Peace [i.e., safety] will be upon you.<sup foot_note=196726>1</sup> I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord. Indeed, He is ever gracious to me.
trs.85: Abraham said, ‘Peace be with you: I will beg my Lord to forgive you- He is always gracious to me-
trs.22: Abraham said: "Peace be on thee: I will pray to my Lord for thy forgiveness: for He is to me Most Gracious.
trs.203: Ibrâhîm (Abraham) said: "Peace be on you! I will ask Forgiveness of my Lord for you. Verily He is unto me Ever Most Gracious.

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَعْتَزِلُكُمْ وَمَا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى عَسَىٰٓ أَلَّآ أَكُونَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّى شَقِيًّا

trs.20: And I will leave you and those you invoke other than Allāh and will invoke<sup foot_note=196727>1</sup> my Lord. I expect that I will not be in invocation to my Lord unhappy [i.e., disappointed]."
trs.85: but for now I will leave you, and the idols you all pray to, and I will pray to my Lord and trust that my prayer will not be in vain.’
trs.22: "And I will turn away from you (all) and from those whom ye invoke besides Allah: I will call on my Lord: perhaps, by my prayer to my Lord, I shall be not unblest."
trs.203: "And I shall turn away from you and from those whom you invoke besides Allâh. And I shall call upon my Lord and I hope that I shall not be unblest in my invocation to my Lord."

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا ٱعْتَزَلَهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ ۖ وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا نَبِيًّا

trs.20: So when he had left them and those they worshipped other than Allāh, We gave him Isaac and Jacob, and each [of them] We made a prophet.
trs.85: When he left his people and those they served beside God, We granted him Isaac and Jacob and made them both prophets:
trs.22: When he had turned away from them and from those whom they worshipped besides Allah, We bestowed on him Isaac and Jacob, and each one of them We made a prophet.
trs.203: So when he had turned away from them and from those whom they worshipped besides Allâh, We gave him Ishâq (Isaac) and Ya‘qûb (Jacob), and each one of them We made a Prophet.

verses.text_uthmani: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِنَا وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ عَلِيًّا

trs.20: And We gave them of Our mercy, and We made for them a mention [i.e., reputation] of high honor.
trs.85: We granted Our grace to all of them, and gave them a noble reputation.
trs.22: And We bestowed of Our Mercy on them, and We granted them lofty honour on the tongue of truth.
trs.203: And We gave them of Our Mercy (a good provision in plenty), and We granted them honour on the tongues (of all the nations, i.e. everybody remembers them with a good praise).<sup foot_note=154704>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مُوسَىٰٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مُخْلَصًا وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَّبِيًّا

trs.20: And mention in the Book, Moses. Indeed, he was chosen, and he was a messenger and a prophet.<sup foot_note=196728>1</sup>
trs.85: Mention too, in the Quran, the story of Moses. He was specially chosen, a messenger and a prophet:
trs.22: Also mention in the Book (the story of) Moses: for he was specially chosen, and he was a messenger (and) a prophet.
trs.203: And mention in the Book (this Qur’ân) Mûsâ (Moses). Verily he was chosen and he was a Messenger (and) a Prophet.

verses.text_uthmani: وَنَـٰدَيْنَـٰهُ مِن جَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلْأَيْمَنِ وَقَرَّبْنَـٰهُ نَجِيًّا

trs.20: And We called him from the side of the mount<sup foot_note=196729>1</sup> at [his] right and brought him near, confiding [to him].
trs.85: We called to him from the right-hand side of the mountain and brought him close to Us in secret communion;
trs.22: And we called him from the right side of Mount (Sinai), and made him draw near to Us, for mystic (converse).
trs.203: And We called him from the right side of the Mount, and made him draw near to Us for a talk with him [Mûsâ (Moses)].

verses.text_uthmani: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥ مِن رَّحْمَتِنَآ أَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ نَبِيًّا

trs.20: And We gave him out of Our mercy his brother Aaron as a prophet.
trs.85: out of Our grace We granted him his brother Aaron as a prophet.
trs.22: And, out of Our Mercy, We gave him his brother Aaron, (also) a prophet.
trs.203: And We granted him his brother Hârûn (Aaron), (also) a Prophet, out of Our Mercy.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صَادِقَ ٱلْوَعْدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَّبِيًّا

trs.20: And mention in the Book, Ishmael. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger and a prophet.
trs.85: Mention too, in the Quran, the story of Ishmael. He was true to his promise, a messenger and a prophet.
trs.22: Also mention in the Book (the story of) Isma'il: He was (strictly) true to what he promised, and he was a messenger (and) a prophet.
trs.203: And mention in the Book (the Qur’ân) Ismâ‘îl (Ishmael). Verily he was true to what he promised, and he was a Messenger, (and) a Prophet.

verses.text_uthmani: وَكَانَ يَأْمُرُ أَهْلَهُۥ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ وَكَانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ مَرْضِيًّا

trs.20: And he used to enjoin on his people prayer and zakāh and was to his Lord pleasing [i.e., accepted by Him].
trs.85: He commanded his household to pray and give alms, and his Lord was well pleased with him.
trs.22: He used to enjoin on his people Prayer and Charity, and he was most acceptable in the sight of his Lord.
trs.203: And he used to enjoin on his family and his people As-Salât (the prayers) and the Zakât and his Lord was pleased with him.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ إِدْرِيسَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَّبِيًّا

trs.20: And mention in the Book, Idrees. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.
trs.85: Mention too, in the Quran, the story of Idris. He was a man of truth, a prophet.
trs.22: Also mention in the Book the case of Idris: He was a man of truth (and sincerity), (and) a prophet:
trs.203: And mention in the Book (the Qur’ân) Idrîs (Enoch).Verily he was a man of truth, (and) a Prophet.

verses.text_uthmani: وَرَفَعْنَـٰهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا

trs.20: And We raised him to a high station.
trs.85: We raised him to a high position.
trs.22: And We raised him to a lofty station.
trs.203: And We raised him to a high station.

verses.text_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ مِن ذُرِّيَّةِ ءَادَمَ وَمِمَّنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّةِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَمِمَّنْ هَدَيْنَا وَٱجْتَبَيْنَآ ۚ إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ خَرُّوا۟ سُجَّدًا وَبُكِيًّا ۩

trs.20: Those were the ones upon whom Allāh bestowed favor from among the prophets of the descendants of Adam and of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel [i.e., Jacob], and of those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of the Most Merciful were recited to them, they fell in prostration and weeping.
trs.85: These were the prophets God blessed- from the seed of Adam, of those We carried in the Ark with Noah, from the seed of Abraham and Israel- and those We guided and chose. When the revelations of the Lord of Mercy were recited to them, they fell to their knees and wept,
trs.22: Those were some of the prophets on whom Allah did bestow His Grace,- of the posterity of Adam, and of those who We carried (in the Ark) with Noah, and of the posterity of Abraham and Israel of those whom We guided and chose. Whenever the Signs of (Allah) Most Gracious were rehearsed to them, they would fall down in prostrate adoration and in tears.
trs.203: Those were they unto whom Allâh bestowed His Grace from among the Prophets, of the offspring of Adam, and of those whom We carried (in the ship) with Nûh (Noah), and of the offspring of Ibrâhîm (Abraham) and Israel, and from among those whom We guided and chose. When the Verses of the Most Gracious (Allâh) were recited unto them, they fell down prostrate and weeping.<sup foot_note=154705>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ فَخَلَفَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ أَضَاعُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَلْقَوْنَ غَيًّا

trs.20: But there came after them successors [i.e., later generations] who neglected prayer and pursued desires; so they are going to meet evil<sup foot_note=196730>1</sup> -
trs.85: but there came after them generations who neglected prayer and were driven by their own desires. These will come face to face with their evil,
trs.22: But after them there followed a posterity who missed prayers and followed after lusts soon, then, will they face Destruction,-
trs.203: Then, there has succeeded them a posterity who have given up As-Salât (the prayers) [i.e. made their Salât (prayers) to be lost, either by not offering them or by not offering them perfectly or by not offering them in their proper fixed times] and have followed lusts.<sup foot_note=154706>1</sup> So they will be thrown in Hell.

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ شَيْـًٔا

trs.20: Except those who repent, believe and do righteousness; for those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged at all.
trs.85: but those who repent, who believe, who do righteous deeds, will enter Paradise. They will not be wronged in the least:
trs.22: Except those who repent and believe, and work righteousness: for these will enter the Garden and will not be wronged in the least,-
trs.203: Except those who repent and believe (in the Oneness of Allâh and His Messenger Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), and work righteousness.<sup foot_note=154707>1</sup> Such will enter Paradise and they will not be wronged in aught.

verses.text_uthmani: جَنَّـٰتِ عَدْنٍ ٱلَّتِى وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ عِبَادَهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَأْتِيًّا

trs.20: [Therein are] gardens of perpetual residence which the Most Merciful has promised His servants in the unseen. Indeed, His promise has ever been eminent.<sup foot_note=196731>1</sup>
trs.85: they will enter the Gardens of Lasting Bliss, promised by the Lord of Mercy to His servants- it is not yet seen but truly His promise will be fulfilled.
trs.22: Gardens of Eternity, those which (Allah) Most Gracious has promised to His servants in the Unseen: for His promise must (necessarily) come to pass.
trs.203: (They will enter) ‘Adn (Eden) Paradise (everlasting Gardens), which the Most Gracious (Allâh) has promised to His slaves in the Unseen: Verily His Promise must come to pass.

verses.text_uthmani: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا إِلَّا سَلَـٰمًا ۖ وَلَهُمْ رِزْقُهُمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا

trs.20: They will not hear therein any ill speech - only [greetings of] peace - and they will have their provision therein, morning and afternoon.
trs.85: There they will hear only peaceful talk, nothing bad; there they will be given provision morning and evening.
trs.22: They will not there hear any vain discourse, but only salutations of Peace: And they will have therein their sustenance, morning and evening.
trs.203: They shall not hear therein (in Paradise) any Laghw (dirty, false, evil vain talk), but only Salâm (salutations of peace). And they will have therein their sustenance, morning and afternoon. [See (V.40:55)].

verses.text_uthmani: تِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِى نُورِثُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا مَن كَانَ تَقِيًّا

trs.20: That is Paradise, which We give as inheritance to those of Our servants who were fearing of Allāh.
trs.85: That is the Garden We shall give as their own to those of Our servants who were devout.
trs.22: Such is the Garden which We give as an inheritance to those of Our servants who guard against Evil.
trs.203: Such is the Paradise which We shall give as an inheritance to those of Our slaves who have been Al-Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2).

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمْرِ رَبِّكَ ۖ لَهُۥ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا وَمَا خَلْفَنَا وَمَا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّا

trs.20: [Gabriel said],<sup foot_note=196732>1</sup> "And we [angels] descend not except by the order of your Lord. To Him belongs that before us and that behind us and what is in between. And never is your Lord forgetful -
trs.85: [Gabriel said],‘We only descend [with revelation] at your Lord’s command––everything before us, everything behind us, everything in between, all belongs to Him––your Lord is never forgetful.
trs.22: (The angels say:) "We descend not but by command of thy Lord: to Him belongeth what is before us and what is behind us, and what is between: and thy Lord never doth forget,-
trs.203: And we (angels) descend not except by the Command of your Lord (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم). To Him belongs what is before us and what is behind us, and what is between those two; and your Lord is never forgetful -

verses.text_uthmani: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَٱعْبُدْهُ وَٱصْطَبِرْ لِعِبَـٰدَتِهِۦ ۚ هَلْ تَعْلَمُ لَهُۥ سَمِيًّا

trs.20: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them - so worship Him and have patience for His worship. Do you know of any similarity to Him?"
trs.85: He is Lord of the heavens and earth and everything in between so worship Him: be steadfast in worshipping Him. Do you know of anyone equal to Him?’
trs.22: "Lord of the heavens and of the earth, and of all that is between them; so worship Him, and be constant and patient in His worship: knowest thou of any who is worthy of the same Name as He?"
trs.203: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, so worship Him (Alone) and be constant and patient in His worship. Do you know of any who is similar to Him? (of course none is similar or co-equal or comparable to Him, and He has none as partner with Him). [There is nothing like Him and He is the All-Hearer, the All-Seer].<sup foot_note=154708>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: وَيَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَءِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوْفَ أُخْرَجُ حَيًّا

trs.20: And man [i.e., the disbeliever] says, "When I have died, am I going to be brought forth alive?"
trs.85: Man says, ‘What? Once I am dead, will I be brought back to life?’
trs.22: Man says: "What! When I am dead, shall I then be raised up alive?"
trs.203: And man (the disbeliever) says: "When I am dead, shall I then be raised up alive?"

verses.text_uthmani: أَوَلَا يَذْكُرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ يَكُ شَيْـًٔا

trs.20: Does man not remember that We created him before, while he was nothing?
trs.85: but does man not remember that We created him when he was nothing before?
trs.22: But does not man call to mind that We created him before out of nothing?
trs.203: Does not man remember that We created him before, while he was nothing?

verses.text_uthmani: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَٱلشَّيَـٰطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّا

trs.20: So by your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils; then We will bring them to be present around Hell upon their knees.<sup foot_note=196733>1</sup>
trs.85: By your Lord [Prophet] We shall gather them and the devils together and set them on their knees around Hell;
trs.22: So, by thy Lord, without doubt, We shall gather them together, and (also) the Evil Ones (with them); then shall We bring them forth on their knees round about Hell;
trs.203: So by your Lord, surely, We shall gather them together, and (also) the Shayâtîn (devils) (with them), then We shall bring them round Hell on their knees.

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمْ أَشَدُّ عَلَى ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عِتِيًّا

trs.20: Then We will surely extract from every sect those of them who were worst against the Most Merciful in insolence.
trs.85: We shall seize out of each group those who were most disobedient towards the Lord of Mercy-
trs.22: Then shall We certainly drag out from every sect all those who were worst in obstinate rebellion against (Allah) Most Gracious.
trs.203: Then indeed We shall drag out from every sect all those who were worst in obstinate rebellion against the Most Gracious (Allâh).

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ لَنَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِهَا صِلِيًّا

trs.20: Then, surely it is We who are most knowing of those most worthy of burning therein.
trs.85: We know best who most deserves to burn in Hell-
trs.22: And certainly We know best those who are most worthy of being burned therein.
trs.203: Then, verily, We know best those who are most worthy of being burnt therein.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِن مِّنكُمْ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَا ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتْمًا مَّقْضِيًّا

trs.20: And there is none of you except he will come to it.<sup foot_note=196734>1</sup> This is upon your Lord an inevitability decreed.
trs.85: but every single one of you will approach it, a decree from your Lord which must be fulfilled.
trs.22: Not one of you but will pass over it: this is, with thy Lord, a Decree which must be accomplished.
trs.203: There is not one of you but will pass over it (Hell): this is with your Lord; a Decree which must be accomplished.<sup foot_note=154709>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّنَذَرُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّا

trs.20: Then We will save those who feared Allāh and leave the wrongdoers within it, on their knees.
trs.85: We shall save the devout and leave the evildoers there on their knees.
trs.22: But We shall save those who guarded against evil, and We shall leave the wrong-doers therein, (humbled) to their knees.
trs.203: Then We shall save those who used to fear Allâh and were dutiful to Him. And We shall leave the Zâlimûn (polytheists and wrongdoers) therein (humbled) to their knees (in Hell).

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُنَا بَيِّنَـٰتٍ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَىُّ ٱلْفَرِيقَيْنِ خَيْرٌ مَّقَامًا وَأَحْسَنُ نَدِيًّا

trs.20: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Which of [our] two parties is best in position and best in association?"<sup foot_note=196735>1</sup>
trs.85: When Our revelations are recited to them in all their clarity, [all that] the disbelievers say to the believers [is], ‘Which side is better situated? Which side has the better following?’
trs.22: When Our Clear Signs are rehearsed to them, the Unbelievers say to those who believe, "Which of the two sides is best in point of position? Which makes the best show in council?"
trs.203: And when Our Clear Verses are recited to them, those who disbelieve (the rich and strong among the pagans of Quraish who live a life of luxury) say to those who believe (the weak, poor companions of Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم who have a hard life): "Which of the two groups (i.e. believers or disbelievers) is best in (point of) position and as regards station (place of council for consultation)."

verses.text_uthmani: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَحْسَنُ أَثَـٰثًا وَرِءْيًا

trs.20: And how many a generation have We destroyed before them who were better in possessions and [outward] appearance?
trs.85: We have destroyed many a generation before them who surpassed them in riches and outward glitter!
trs.22: But how many (countless) generations before them have we destroyed, who were even better in equipment and in glitter to the eye?
trs.203: And how many a generation (past nations) have We destroyed before them, who were better in wealth, goods and outward appearance?

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلضَّلَـٰلَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ مَدًّا ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَأَضْعَفُ جُندًا

trs.20: Say, "Whoever is in error - let the Most Merciful extend for him an extension [in wealth and time] until, when they see that which they were promised - either punishment [in this world] or the Hour [of resurrection] - they will come to know who is worst in position and weaker in soldiers."
trs.85: Say [Prophet], ‘The Lord of Mercy lengthens [the lives] of the misguided, until, when they are confronted with what they have been warned about- either the punishment [in this life] or the Hour [of Judgement]- they realize who is worse situated and who has the weakest forces.’
trs.22: Say: "If any men go astray, (Allah) Most Gracious extends (the rope) to them, until, when they see the warning of Allah (being fulfilled) - either in punishment or in (the approach of) the Hour,- they will at length realise who is worst in position, and (who) weakest in forces!
trs.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) whoever is in error, the Most Gracious (Allâh) will extend (the rope) to him, until, when they see that which they were promised, either the torment or the Hour, they will come to know who is worst in position, and who is weaker in forces. [This is the answer to the question in Verse No.19:73]

verses.text_uthmani: وَيَزِيدُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱهْتَدَوْا۟ هُدًى ۗ وَٱلْبَـٰقِيَـٰتُ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتُ خَيْرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ مَّرَدًّا

trs.20: And Allāh increases those who were guided, in guidance, and the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord<sup foot_note=196736>1</sup> for reward and better for recourse.
trs.85: But God gives more guidance to those who are guided, and good deeds of lasting merit are best and most rewarding in your Lord’s sight.
trs.22: "And Allah doth advance in guidance those who seek guidance: and the things that endure, Good Deeds, are best in the sight of thy Lord, as rewards, and best in respect of (their) eventual return."
trs.203: And Allâh increases in guidance those who walk aright.<sup foot_note=154710>1</sup> And the righteous good deeds that last, are better with your Lord, for reward and better for resort.

verses.text_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى كَفَرَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالًا وَوَلَدًا

trs.20: Then, have you seen he who disbelieved in Our verses and said, "I will surely be given wealth and children [in the next life]"?
trs.85: Have you considered the man who rejects Our revelation, who says, ‘I will certainly be given wealth and children’?
trs.22: Hast thou then seen the (sort of) man who rejects Our Signs, yet says: "I shall certainly be given wealth and children?"
trs.203: Have you seen him who disbelieved in Our Ayât (this Qur’ân and Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) and said: "I shall certainly be given wealth and children [if I will be alive (again)]."

verses.text_uthmani: أَطَّلَعَ ٱلْغَيْبَ أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَهْدًا

trs.20: Has he looked into the unseen, or has he taken from the Most Merciful a promise?
trs.85: Has he penetrated the unknown or received a pledge to that effect from the Lord of Mercy?
trs.22: Has he penetrated to the Unseen, or has he taken a contract with (Allah) Most Gracious?
trs.203: Has he known the Unseen or has he taken a covenant from the Most Gracious (Allâh)?

verses.text_uthmani: كَلَّا ۚ سَنَكْتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ مَدًّا

trs.20: No! We will record what he says and extend [i.e., increase] for him from the punishment extensively.
trs.85: No! We shall certainly record what he says and prolong his punishment:
trs.22: Nay! We shall record what he says, and We shall add and add to his punishment.
trs.203: Nay, We shall record what he says, and We shall increase his torment (in the Hell);

verses.text_uthmani: وَنَرِثُهُۥ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَأْتِينَا فَرْدًا

trs.20: And We will inherit him [in] what he mentions,<sup foot_note=196737>1</sup> and he will come to Us alone.
trs.85: We shall inherit from him all that he speaks of and he will come to Us all alone.
trs.22: To Us shall return all that he talks of and he shall appear before Us bare and alone.
trs.203: And We shall inherit from him (at his death) all that he talks of (i.e. wealth and children which We have bestowed upon him in this world), and he shall come to Us alone.

translation.text: and he will come to Us

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً لِّيَكُونُوا۟ لَهُمْ عِزًّا

trs.20: And they have taken besides Allāh [false] deities that they would be for them [a source of] honor.
trs.85: They have taken other gods beside God to give them strength,
trs.22: And they have taken (for worship) gods other than Allah, to give them power and glory!
trs.203: And they have taken (for worship) âlihah (gods) besides Allâh, that they might give them honour, power and glory (and also protect them from Allâh’s punishment).

verses.text_uthmani: كَلَّا ۚ سَيَكْفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا

trs.20: No! They [i.e., those "gods"] will deny their worship of them and will be against them opponents [on the Day of Judgement].
trs.85: but these gods will reject their worship and will even turn against them.
trs.22: Instead, they shall reject their worship, and become adversaries against them.
trs.203: Nay, but they (the so-called gods) will deny their worship of them, and become opponents to them (on the Day of Resurrection).

verses.text_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينَ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّا

trs.20: Do you not see that We have sent the devils upon the disbelievers, inciting them [to evil] with [constant] incitement?
trs.85: Have you [Prophet] not seen how We send devils to incite the disbelievers to sin?
trs.22: Seest thou not that We have set the Evil Ones on against the unbelievers, to incite them with fury?
trs.203: See you not that We have sent the Shayâtîn (devils) against the disbelievers to push them to do evil.

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمْ عَدًّا

trs.20: So be not impatient over them. We only count out [i.e., allow] to them a [limited] number.<sup foot_note=196738>1</sup>
trs.85: There is no need for you to be impatient concerning them: We are counting down their [allotted] time.
trs.22: So make no haste against them, for We but count out to them a (limited) number (of days).
trs.203: So make no haste against them; We only count out to them a (limited) number (of the days of the life of this world and delay their term so that they may increase in evil and sins).

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ وَفْدًا

trs.20: On the Day We will gather the righteous to the Most Merciful as a delegation
trs.85: On the Day We gather the righteous as an honoured company before the Lord of Mercy
trs.22: The day We shall gather the righteous to (Allah) Most Gracious, like a band presented before a king for honours,
trs.203: The Day We shall gather the Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2) unto the Most Gracious (Allâh), like a delegation (presented before a king for honour).

verses.text_uthmani: وَنَسُوقُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وِرْدًا

trs.20: And will drive the criminals to Hell in thirst
trs.85: and drive the sinful like a thirsty herd into Hell,
trs.22: And We shall drive the sinners to Hell, like thirsty cattle driven down to water,-
trs.203: And We shall drive the Mujrimûn (polytheists, sinners, criminals, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh) to Hell, in a thirsty state (like a thirsty herd driven down to water).

verses.text_uthmani: لَّا يَمْلِكُونَ ٱلشَّفَـٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَهْدًا

trs.20: None will have [power of] intercession except he who had taken from the Most Merciful a covenant.<sup foot_note=196739>1</sup>
trs.85: no one will have power to intercede except for those who have permission from the Lord of Mercy.
trs.22: None shall have the power of intercession, but such a one as has received permission (or promise) from (Allah) Most Gracious.
trs.203: None shall have the power of intercession, but such a one as has received permission (or promise) from the Most Gracious (Allâh).

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَلَدًا

trs.20: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken [for Himself] a son."
trs.85: The disbelievers say, ‘The Lord of Mercy has offspring.’
trs.22: They say: "(Allah) Most Gracious has begotten a son!"
trs.203: And they say: "The Most Gracious (Allâh) has begotten a son (or offspring or children) [as the Jews say: ‘Uzair (Ezra) is the son of Allâh, and the Christians say that He has begotten a son [‘Îsâ (Jesus) عليه السلام], and the pagan Arabs say that He has begotten daughters (angels and others.)]."

verses.text_uthmani: لَّقَدْ جِئْتُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِدًّا

trs.20: You have done an atrocious thing.
trs.85: How terrible is this thing you assert:
trs.22: Indeed ye have put forth a thing most monstrous!
trs.203: Indeed you have brought forth (said) a terrible evil thing.

verses.text_uthmani: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْهُ وَتَنشَقُّ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَتَخِرُّ ٱلْجِبَالُ هَدًّا

trs.20: The heavens almost rupture therefrom and the earth splits open and the mountains collapse in devastation
trs.85: it almost causes the heavens to be torn apart, the earth to split asunder, the mountains to crumble to pieces,
trs.22: At it the skies are ready to burst, the earth to split asunder, and the mountains to fall down in utter ruin,
trs.203: Whereby the heavens are almost torn, and the earth is split asunder, and the mountains fall in ruins,

verses.text_uthmani: أَن دَعَوْا۟ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ وَلَدًا

trs.20: That they attribute to the Most Merciful a son.
trs.85: that they attribute offspring to the Lord of Mercy.
trs.22: That they should invoke a son for (Allah) Most Gracious.
trs.203: That they ascribe a son (or offspring or children) to the Most Gracious (Allâh).

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا

trs.20: And it is not appropriate for the Most Merciful that He should take a son.
trs.85: It does not befit the Lord of Mercy [to have offspring]:
trs.22: For it is not consonant with the majesty of (Allah) Most Gracious that He should beget a son.
trs.203: But it is not suitable for (the Majesty of) the Most Gracious (Allâh) that He should beget a son (or offspring or children).

verses.text_uthmani: إِن كُلُّ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّآ ءَاتِى ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَبْدًا

trs.20: There is no one in the heavens and earth but that he comes to the Most Merciful as a servant.
trs.85: there is no one in the heavens or earth who will not come to the Lord of Mercy as a servant-
trs.22: Not one of the beings in the heavens and the earth but must come to (Allah) Most Gracious as a servant.
trs.203: There is none in the heavens and the earth but comes unto the Most Gracious (Allâh) as a slave.

verses.text_uthmani: لَّقَدْ أَحْصَىٰهُمْ وَعَدَّهُمْ عَدًّا

trs.20: He has enumerated them and counted them a [full] counting.
trs.85: He has counted them all: He has numbered them exactly-
trs.22: He does take an account of them (all), and hath numbered them (all) exactly.
trs.203: Verily He knows each one of them, and has counted them a full counting.

verses.text_uthmani: وَكُلُّهُمْ ءَاتِيهِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فَرْدًا

trs.20: And all of them are coming to Him on the Day of Resurrection alone.
trs.85: and they will each return to Him on the Day of Resurrection all alone.
trs.22: And everyone of them will come to Him singly on the Day of Judgment.
trs.203: And everyone of them will come to Him alone on the Day of Resurrection (without any helper, or protector or defender).

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وُدًّا

trs.20: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection.<sup foot_note=196740>1</sup>
trs.85: But the Lord of Mercy will give love to those who believe and do righteous deeds:
trs.22: On those who believe and work deeds of righteousness, will (Allah) Most Gracious bestow love.
trs.203: Verily, those who believe [in the Oneness of Allâh and in His Messenger (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)] and work deeds of righteousness, the Most Gracious (Allâh) will bestow love for them<sup foot_note=154711>1</sup> (in the hearts of the believers).

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَـٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنذِرَ بِهِۦ قَوْمًا لُّدًّا

trs.20: So, [O Muḥammad], We have only made it [i.e., the Qur’ān] easy in your tongue [i.e., the Arabic language] that you may give good tidings thereby to the righteous and warn thereby a hostile people.
trs.85: We have made it easy, in your own language [Prophet], so that you may bring glad news to the righteous and warnings to a stubborn people.
trs.22: So have We made the (Qur'an) easy in thine own tongue, that with it thou mayest give Glad Tidings to the righteous, and warnings to people given to contention.
trs.203: So We have made this (the Qur’ân) easy in your own tongue (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), only that you may give glad tidings to the Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2), and warn with it the Ludd<sup foot_note=154712>1</sup> (most quarrelsome) people.

translation.text: that you may give glad tidings

verses.text_uthmani: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هَلْ تُحِسُّ مِنْهُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ أَوْ تَسْمَعُ لَهُمْ رِكْزًۢا

trs.20: And how many have We destroyed before them of generations? Do you perceive of them anyone or hear from them a sound?
trs.85: How many generations We have destroyed before them! Do you perceive a single one of them now, or hear as much as a whisper?
trs.22: But how many (countless) generations before them have We destroyed? Canst thou find a single one of them (now) or hear (so much as) a whisper of them?
trs.203: And how many a generation before them have We destroyed! Can you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) find a single one of them or hear even a whisper of them?
